preflight_reserves: every possible started journal event in the current model-tool batch
every completed SUCCESS or ERROR event in that batch
every deferred admission event in that batch
every later deferred resolution completion event and lifecycle identity
event_outbox_contract.storage_strategy: reserve lifecycle outbox capacity before the first external tool effect; an equivalent independent outbox store may be used when it has no fixed cardinality or byte cap
